decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Psychatog as a win condition while controlling the game with spells like Counterspell and Smother. It also includes card draw and library manipulation to dig for key pieces. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up resources and eventually overwhelming them with the powerful Psychatog. The deck has a good balance of control elements and card advantage to outmaneuver opponents and secure victories.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells while using Oath of Druids to quickly ramp into powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck also includes cards like Call of the Herd and Sylvan Library to generate additional threats and card advantage. Cataclysm is used as a board wipe, while Treetop Village and Wasteland provide additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient removal and powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently set up the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a winning condition. The deck includes various counter spells and card draw to help find the pieces of the combo, while also providing control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win through resolving the combo as early as possible, while maintaining a strong control over the game through countering and disrupting the opponent's plays.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering opponent's spells, drawing cards, and removing threats from the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate. It aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence with creatures like Psychatog and Shadowmage Infiltrator. It also uses efficient mana sources like Mox Diamond to accelerate its plays and disrupt opponent's strategies with Meddling Mage. Overall, the deck excels at disrupting opponent's plans and outvaluing them in the long game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Elves, fueled by mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania. The deck aims to quickly build a large board presence, with cards like Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte providing additional value and pressure. The use of cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger allows for flexibility and protection against removal spells. The deck also has a toolbox approach with cards like Survival of the Fittest to search for specific creatures when needed.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly get key creatures onto the battlefield, followed by powerful Goblin lords like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator provide additional reach and removal options to help secure the win. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Goblin Sharpshooter and disruption spells like Terminate and Smother to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck utilizes a combination of cards that allow the player to quickly and efficiently set up a powerful board state by returning enchantments from the graveyard to the battlefield. By using cards like Attunement, Intuition, and Replenish, the player can fill their graveyard with enchantments and then bring them back with Opalescence to turn them into powerful creatures. Parallax Tide and Parallax Wave offer control elements, while Stifle and Seal of Cleansing provide additional support. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong enchantment-based army.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo in conjunction with cards like Stifle and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By taking advantage of card draw spells like Gush and Impulse, as well as protection spells like Foil and Daze, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game. The inclusion of Vision Charm and Portent helps to set up key draws, while Flooded Strand ensures mana consistency. The strategy revolves around efficiently controlling the game while setting up the game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on using the mana acceleration provided by elves like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves to quickly play out powerful creatures like Multani's Acolyte, Priest of Titania, and Wirewood Symbiote. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Tangle Wire and Nantuko Vigilante to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck's win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of elves and powerful creatures, supported by cards like Survival of the Fittest and Biorhythm to maintain a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly search for key creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes removal options with Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize to deal with threats from the opponent. With mana acceleration from cards like Skirk Prospector and Wasteland disruption, the Goblins seek to establish dominance on the battlefield and secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of goblins, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Piledriver to deal damage rapidly. Survival of the Fittest helps to search for key goblin creatures, while other cards like Skirk Prospector and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional utility and power. The deck also includes some mana acceleration with cards like Birds of Paradise and Gaea's Cradle to help cast powerful creatures quickly. The strategy is to build a board presence early and aggressively attack to defeat the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to pressure opponents and control the board. It uses cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy to strip away opponent's resources, while creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Withered Wretch apply pressure and disrupt opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Snuff Out and Smother to deal with threats. Overall, Mono Black Aggro aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents by presenting a quick and versatile threat while disrupting their strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while ramping up to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Terravore. It uses cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland to slow down the opponent, while also utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly bring out key creatures from the deck. The control aspect is further emphasized with cards like Sylvan Library and Rishadan Port, allowing the player to manipulate their draws and keep the opponent at a disadvantage.

The main strategy of this deck is to lock down the opponent with Stasis, preventing them from untapping their permanents while using cards like Gush and Chain of Vapor to continuously bounce Stasis back to their hand. The deck also includes cards like Black Vise and Forsaken City to pressure the opponent's life total. Additionally, there are counterspells like Counterspell and Thwart to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can combo off for a win.

The primary focus of this deck is to establish and maintain control over the game by utilizing the Stasis combo. By combining cards like Black Vise, Counterspell, and Thwart with the Stasis enchantment, the deck creates a lockout situation where opponents are unable to untap their permanents, effectively stalling their gameplay. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Gush and Impulse to help draw into key combo pieces quickly and efficiently. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up the Stasis lock to secure victory.

The main concept of this UW Tron control deck is to stall the game through counterspells and removal spells, while using mana fixing and card draw to set up for powerful late game plays. The deck utilizes a Tron land base to generate large amounts of colorless mana, allowing for big mana plays like Decree of Justice and Stroke of Genius. The goal is to control the board, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and eventually win through card advantage and powerful finishers like Masticore.
